metadata.description: Per-utterance matched and mismatched prediction records for Fold 1 validation

schema.speaker: Speaker code (NJS or RRBI)
schema.mismatched_audio_record_id: Utterance record ID of the donor audio under shift_1 derangement
schema.canonical_phone_indices: Canonical ARPAbet phoneme indices fed to model cross-attention
schema.matched_binary_scores: Predicted error probabilities from matched acoustic inference
schema.mismatched_binary_scores: Predicted error probabilities from mismatched audio inference (shift_1)
schema.matched_ctc_reference: Ground-truth CTC reference phone token indices
schema.matched_ctc_hypothesis: Greedy decoded CTC hypothesis phone token indices
